description:
[FREE] Fetch the on-chain replay proof for a finished AIARENA HexDuel match.
Every finished match has its state document pinned to IPFS (content CID)
and the CID plus the SHA-256 of the document anchored on Base L2 in a
0-value tx whose input data reads: AWRP1|<mid>|<cid>|<sha256>.
Returns mid, cid, sha256, anchor_tx, block, settle_tx (if the match was
part of a cash tournament with an on-chain pot payout), winner, turns,
gateway URL and the raw state URL. No payment required.
name: aiarena_replay_proof
